title: Simplified Recipies (Majnin Official Datapack)
description: Datapack that Simplifies some of the Minecraft recipies and adds new recipies to the game.
body: Datapack that Simplifies some of the Minecraft recipies and adds new recipies to the game. Recipies of the Anvil and the Golden Apple are changed from: - Golden Apple - original: 8 gold ingots - datapack: 4 gold ingots (recipe in images) - Anvil - original: 3 iron blocks, 4 ingots - datapack: 1 iron block, 6 iron ingots (recipe in images) Crafting recipies for Chainmail Armor added, recipies are in images Bamboo now makes Lime Dye, you can smelt white dye for Prismarine Crystals, light blue dye for Prismarine Shards Prismarine and Prismarine Bricks now have recipe that does not make 1 Pris. or Pris. Brick but 4 Same for Quartz, you use 4 Quartz in a specific state and it makes 4 not one Quartz block
